lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Silas? You're already here... and you're human?!

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: I swam back after the fight, but when I climbed out... I changed. I still don't know how!

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: I was scared you wouldn't make it back, too.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'm here. Let's get you somewhere safe to recover.
